AI has made my research better. But I realized today it’s also costing me something...

When I was in middle school, I asked my grandpa what a word meant. He told me to go grab the dictionary and look it up. I asked why I couldn’t just look it up online. He said that would get me the answer for sure, but I’d be missing something. When you open a dictionary, you see all the words next to the one you’re looking up, and you end up learning a few of those too. Looking it up online gets you the one word and nothing around it. No serendipity.

Zooming out, the internet era already lost some of that serendipity. It used to be that for a research project, you had to go find a book in the library. Root cause:
VestingManager.release() subtracts claimed shares from global _totalTokenShares but leaves them in the position's _depositedShares. 
After release → topUpVesting(), cancel() calculates sharesToRemove from the full lifetime _depositedShares without subtracting schedule released, 

so already-released shares are removed from the global total a second time. 

The attacker used a direct donation to magnify this stale-share debit, 

corrupted the denominator, then released a second attacker-owned vesting to take tokens backing unrelated users.
